company_name: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited

equity_bridge.note: FY2026 AR consolidated balance sheet, equity attributable to NCI

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2019-FY2026 revenue CAGR 5.1% (much of it gold-price pass-through on falling volumes) tempered toward nominal mid-cycle growth
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (~0% 5yr) diverges >30% from revenue (6.1%) and EPS (8.4%) CAGRs because the group pays out 73-93% of profit plus specials (FY2024 HK$0.72) and a FY2026 buy-back; book value is not a growth proxy here.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs (reported FCF less SBC; interest income not stripped, net-debt company) are meaningless on FY2026's working-capital trough (HK$698m vs HK$8,084m FY2023 and HK$9,637m FY2021) and are not used for growth selection. SBC is immaterial (HK$25m), so the SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs are effectively identical; the collapse is gold-driven inventory, not SBC.

scenario_narratives.base: Brand transformation sticks but the FY2026 gold windfall does not repeat. Fixed-price, design-led product keeps gaining share of Mainland retail value and the store network stabilises after the closure wave, so EBITDA margin settles at ~12% (after the gold-loan hedge cost) versus 10.5-11.4% in FY2022-25 and 14.75% at the FY2026 peak. Revenue grows 3-4.5% nominal from mid-single-digit SSSG, overseas openings (SE Asia, North America) and gold-price pass-through; that growth ties up inventory at a quarter of every incremental dollar of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold stays structurally high and Chow Tai Fook converts its brand reset into a durable luxury positioning: fixed-price and heritage collections lift gross margin further, HK/Macao tourist spend keeps recovering (FY2026 SSSG HK 13.3%, Macao 29.4%), overseas stores scale, and Mainland demand for gold as a store of value persists. Revenue compounds 5-9% for five years and EBITDA margin holds 13.5%, much of the FY2026 step-up proving structural.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold reverses from its 2026 spike, weight-based gold jewellery demand falls with it, and Mainland discretionary spending stays weak while Laopu-style premium competitors and bank/online gold bar channels take share. Revenue dips then grows ~2%, the FY2026 holding gains unwind into margin pressure, and EBITDA margin falls to 10%, below the FY2022-25 range. Shrinking revenue releases inventory cash in year one, which is why the bear value does not collapse further.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the jewellery franchise on mid-cycle owner FCF, not on FY2026's peak earnings or its trough cash flow. Gold loans are an operating hedge of inventory, so their fair-value loss and carry are charged in EBITDA and the loans live in working capital; only bank debt and the convertible bond sit in net debt. Leases are an operating cost. A 13x terminal cap reflects a cyclical, gold-exposed retailer.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price reversal: lowers revenue, unwinds holding gains, compresses margin (partly offset by inventory cash release)
Mid-cycle margin judgment: each 1pp of EBITDA margin is worth roughly HK$0.9-1.0/share
Working-capital intensity: inventory runs ~364 days of COGS; capture of -25% of revenue growth may understate cash absorption if gold-loan hedging is cut back
Mainland China consumption and competition from premium gold-craft brands
Convertible bond (HK$7.2bn, conversion HK$16.66) dilutes 396.5m shares if the price rises above conversion; modelled as debt

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 10.34-16.95
data_sources.financials: 1929.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2019-FY2026 + H1 FY2024-26); FY2026 Annual Report: financial highlights (net debt composition, gold loans, CB), cash flow statement (lease principal, capex, SBC), finance-cost note (gold-loan and lease finance costs), EPS note (share counts), CB note (conversion price HK$16.66)
data_sources.qualitative: FY2026 Annual Report strategy, outlook and MD&A; 1929.HK_Analysis.json (read after first build; its bull/bear axes, gold reversal, Laopu Gold competition, Q1 FY2027 ASP-led RSV growth with Mainland SSSG volume -5.2%, matched the scenarios, so no driver changed)

inputs.share_count_basis: 9,865.4m issued shares at 31 Mar 2026 (FY2026 AR p.9277, after the 122.4m concurrent buy-back cancelled 24 Jun 2025) + 2.4m dilutive share-award shares. The 396.5m convertible-bond conversion shares in the 10,289.7m diluted EPS count are EXCLUDED because the HK$7,218m 2030 CB is held as debt in net debt instead; conversion price HK$16.66 vs a HK$11.18 price is out of the money. Counting both would double-charge the bond. Held flat: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 AR cash flow statement share-award expense HK$25.4m (FY2025 12.8, FY2024 6.0, nil before); no equity-award tax withholding (EquityAwardTaxes 0). Interest income (HK$159m) NOT stripped: the group is net-debt, not net-cash.
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows, HKD pegged to USD: risk-free ~4.0% (US/HK 10y), ERP 5.5% plus ~0.5pp for Mainland-consumer concentration (~80% of revenue), beta ~1.0 -> cost of equity ~10%. Pre-tax debt cost ~3% (bank borrowings 2.2-3.6%, CB coupon-equivalent ~4%), ~2.4% after tax, ~10% debt weight at market -> WACC ~9.0%. Same WACC in all scenarios: risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease principal HK$834.4m + lease interest HK$38m (FY2026 CF statement / finance-cost note) = ~0.92% of revenue charged through lease_cost_pct_path; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (total D&A 1,804.6 less ROU depreciation 853.5 = ~951, 1.0% of revenue); lease liabilities (HK$1,005.8m) EXCLUDED from net debt.
inputs.gold_loan_treatment: Gold loans (HK$13,681m at 31 Mar 2026; 24,488 FY24, 15,867 FY25) are treated as an OPERATING liability, not financial debt. They are borrowed physical gold, rolled within 12 months, sized with inventory, and exist to hedge the gold content of inventory: the hedged inventory's holding gain sits in gross profit and the loan's fair-value loss (FY2026 HK$6,275m) sits in other gains and losses. The EBITDA margin path is therefore anchored on EBITDA AFTER the gold-loan fair-value loss AND after the gold-loan finance cost (HK$297m), so the hedge and its carry are charged in the flows; the loans themselves sit inside operating working capital (wc_capture) and are kept OUT of net debt. Charging them in the bridge too would double-count. The company's own net-debt definition (HK$17,397m) includes them; the difference to this model's 3,716 is exactly the 13,681 gold-loan balance.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI deducted once in the equity bridge at book (HK$985.4m, FY2026 balance sheet); NCI share of profit is ~0.8% (HK$76.1m), flows otherwise consolidated.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations. Routed as a non-US consumer operating company (jewellery retail/brand, ~6,000 POS, Mainland China + HK/Macao). First valuation; no prior DCF or memory entry. NET DEBT = bank borrowings 4,760 + convertible bonds 7,218 - cash and deposits 8,262 = 3,716 (gold loans operating, leases operating; see gold_loan_treatment / lease_treatment). BASE YEAR: FY2026 reported FCF of HK$723.6m (and negative H1 FY2026 OCF) is NOT a run-rate: operating cash flow before working capital was HK$21,233m but inventory rose ~HK$8.3bn on the balance sheet as gold prices spiked, and gold loans were paid down 2.2bn. The model therefore does not compound from last_fcf; each year is built from components off FY2026 revenue. EBITDA CALIBRATION (post gold-loan FV loss, post gold-loan finance cost, ex interest income, IFRS16 basis): FY2022 ~11.0%, FY2023 ~10.5%, FY2024 ~10.5%, FY2025 ~11.4%, FY2026 ~14.75% (operating profit 18,850 + D&A 1,805 - gold-loan FV loss 6,275 - gold-loan finance cost 297 - interest income 159 = 13,924). FY2026 is a peak year (H2 FY2026 margin ~17.8% on the gold-price spike vs H1 11.7%), partly structural (fixed-price mix 30.6%->higher of Mainland retail value, weak-store closures). Base fades to 12.0% mid-cycle, above the 10.5-11.4% FY22-25 range for the structural mix shift. WORKING CAPITAL: operating NWC including gold loans as a liability (current assets ex cash less current liabilities ex bank borrowings) ran 17-23% of revenue FY2022-FY2025 and 29% at FY2026 (inventory build); wc_capture -25% of the revenue CHANGE (growth consumes cash; inventory 364 days of COGS). Revenue growth is partly gold-price pass-through, so inventory value scales with it. GROSS-MARGIN DISCONTINUITY FY2023->FY2024 is a presentation change (gold-loan impact moved out of COGS), not operating; this model works off operating profit, which is unaffected. Buybacks: FY2026 HK$1,575m was a one-off concurrent buy-back alongside the CB issue, not a programme; the flat count is a modelling convention since SBC is immaterial. Dividend payout runs 73-93% (FY2024 HK$12.5bn included a HK$0.72 special). SBC-zero-ish market: SBC 0.03% of revenue, so house and street nearly coincide. Scenario axes come from the FY2026 annual report and were checked against the Analysis JSON (gold price direction, Laopu Gold and wholesale-gold competition, HK/Macao tourism, overseas expansion to 100+ stores by FY2030). Q1 FY2027 RSV growth was ASP-led while Mainland volume fell 5.2%, which supports a 6% base year-1 that is mostly gold pass-through.

base.narrative: FY2027 holds some of FY2026's gold-price and fixed-price-mix lift (management: resilient FY2027 to date, far fewer store closures), then margin settles at 12% EBITDA, above the FY22-25 10.5-11.4% range for the structural mix shift. Nominal growth 3-4.5% from modest SSSG, overseas stores and gold pass-through.
base.tax_rationale: FY2026 tax 2,865 / PBT 11,946 = 24.0% (Mainland 25%, HK 16.5%, dividend withholding); cash taxes paid 2,428. Held at 24% in every scenario.
base.capex_rationale: Purchase of PPE 509-593m FY2025-26 (~0.6%) was a closure-heavy trough; FY2019-23 ran 1.4-2.1% of revenue. FY2027 store-revamp acceleration -> 1.1%, settling at 1.0% = maintenance D&A ex-ROU.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because FY2026 earnings sit on a gold-price peak that the company does not control and Mainland consumption remains soft. Base 50%: the central case keeps part of the structural mix shift. Bull trimmed to 25% because it needs gold to stay high AND the transformation to hold AND overseas expansion to scale, three independent things.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
